subject: SIG kickoff: questionnaire selection & evidence owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@meditek.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG kickoff: questionnaire selection & evidence owners

Laura — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can get the SIG/CAIQ work scoped and ownership clear.

Call recap (high level)
- Meditek wants a security questionnaire for procurement (HIPAA + SOC 2 considerations).
- Your team prefers the SIG format but mentioned theres a short custom annex you sometimes use for healthcare customers.
- We discussed SOC 2 evidence availability and whether a partial prefill would speed things up.

Questions we still have
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm the latest SOC 2 Type II date and whether we can share the full report or need a redacted copy? (we can accept either; redaction is fine if sensitive)
2) DPA/GDPR: is a signed DPA already in place?
3) Evidence owner: who on your team should we work with for document uploads and quick clarifications?
4) Questionnaire preference: SIG, CAIQ, or SIG + your custom annex?

Proposed next steps & timeline (suggested)
- Today: you confirm the items above and provide an evidence contact.
- Week 1 (prefill): Redwood sends an initial SIG prefill for review (we can pre-populate service descriptions, hosting, and policy links).
- Week 2 (evidence): Meditek reviews prefill and uploads requested artifacts; Redwood addresses clarifying Qs.

Im attaching a short matrix that highlights when we recommend SIG vs CAIQ for different procurement workflows — should help decide the path quickly.

Attachments: redwood_sig-vs-caiq-matrix.pdf (summary matrix)

If youre good with the approach, please reply with the evidence owner and SOC 2 note and well kick the prefill work off. Happy to schedule a short follow-up with your security lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Redwood | https://www.redwood.com

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap, that matches our notes. Answers below and a quick attachment to get you started.

1) SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II in September 2025. The full report is internal; we can provide a redacted version or a SOC bridge letter. Heres a link to the report we typically share (redacted): https://drive.redwood.com/reports/soc2/meditek-soc2-202509.pdf
2) DPA/GDPR: DPA is already signed and on file with procurement. No additional GDPR steps required at this time.
3) Evidence owner: Ben Cho (ben.cho@meditek.com) — hell own uploads and any technical evidence requests.
4) Questionnaire preference: SIG preferred + our small healthcare annex (well attach the annex to the prefill). Were okay with a partial prefill from Redwood.

Timeline: Ben indicated his team can turn around prefill clarifications in ~5 business days and then gather artifacts within 7–10 business days after clarifications. If we start the prefill this week we expect a complete evidence set within two weeks.

Attached: meditek-sig-prefill-demo.xlsx — small example of their annex and a sample evidence index.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement
MediTek Solutions

Quick internal note — thanks Laura for the details (copied above). Two clarifying items for the prefill approach:

- Delivery model: do we want Redwood to fully prefill the SIG and send a single file back to Ben for his upload, or do we want to work in their portal (they did not mention a vendor portal)? Prefill + single file is usually fastest.
- SOC 2 handling: since Meditek can only share a redacted SOC 2, do we ask for the redacted report + a bridge letter, or accept redacted only and mark the remaining questions as evidence pending? Id lean to asking for redacted + bridge letter to minimize follow-ups.

If Kimberly is aligned Ill draft the prefill template and include placeholder notes for the SOC 2 items and the annex.
